paper.title: The Dynamics and Spillovers of Management Interventions: Evidence from the Training within Industry Program

claims.claim: 7% of applicants received all three J-modules.
90% of trained firms survived at least 10 years.
64% of nontrained firms survived at least 10 years.
Training reduced the exit rate by 26 percentage points.
Sales increased by 5.3% in the first post-training year.
Sales reached a peak increase of 21.7% in period 8.
Applicant firms employed 40% of the US manufacturing workforce in 1939.

findings.description: The translated Figure 3 period-8 sales effect is 21.8% after converting the coefficient to a percentage, while the paper reports 21.7%.
findings.suggested_fix: Review the original Stata model output and the paper's percent conversion/display calculation.

findings.description: This benchmark bundle translates and executes Figure 2, Figure 3, Figure A3A, Table A4 and Table 1 panel A only. It does not enumerate or check every numeric result in the article or execute all 43 master-listed do-files.
findings.evidence: code/run_translation.R contains these translated components; the supplied master file lists 43 figure/table scripts.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate and execute the remaining shipped scripts, then enumerate and check every numeric claim in the full article.

limitations: The package contains prebuilt analysis .dta files, not upstream raw-data construction code; no upstream construction steps can be translated from absent source.

Coverage is partial: the abstract and main text values listed here were checked, along with Table 1 panel A computations. The remaining body text and all table/appendix results were not enumerated or checked. This certificate does not claim a complete paper-wide audit.
Stata was unavailable. R 4.6.1 and haven 2.5.5, fixest 0.14.2, and survival were used for a direct translation of selected shipped Stata analyses.
